title: 第5章 山中夜宴第6章 雨夜值守
content_zh:
第5章山中夜宴
刘长旭是一个对修仙生活很讲究的人，他平日吃的都是灵果、灵膳，很少食用凡人食物和丹药。
为了在这次外出猎妖中吃到可口的灵膳，特意在储物袋中带了这些餐饮用具，甚至连烤肉用的灵木炭都带上一些。
他对一些修士为了追求长生不老，不娶道侣、一味苦修的生活态度很不理解。
不知道他们修仙图的是什么，是长久的孤独吗？即便修炼到更高境界，拥有更长寿元又能如何！
他认为修仙之路漫长而坎坷！在追求长生不老的修仙之路上，除了要不断提高自己的修为，以便拥有更长寿元的同时，也要学会享受当下美好的修仙生活。
他这样的修仙生活态度，来源于他的那位灵膳师的母亲。
母亲林玉莲对刘长旭的日常修仙生活非常关注，总是竭尽所能的为刘长旭创造最好的修仙生活环境。
为了能够使儿女从小打下良好的修仙基础，自儿子出生后，就开始学习制作灵膳，并尽其所能的为儿子的修炼供应所需的各种灵膳。
虽然刘长旭的父亲是一名炼丹师，但是母亲林玉莲从小就要求刘长旭，如无必要不得服用丹药提升修为。
这是由于长期服用丹药，会在修士体内产生丹毒。日积月累之下，丹毒就会影响到修士日后修为的突破！
在母亲的熏陶下，他也喜欢上了制作和食用灵膳，并将其作为提高自己修为的一项重要手段，长期不断的食用灵膳为刘长旭的修仙之路打下了良好的根基
在母亲林玉莲的指导帮助下，刘长旭目前已经基本达到了一阶下品灵膳师的水平，尤以是以烤肉水平最佳。
灵膳师也是修仙百艺之一，很多可以食用的灵材，如果不经过灵膳师的加工制作，会难以下咽且食用效果不佳。
不同的食材需要灵膳师采用不同的加工处理手段。很多食材的加工处理很是繁琐，但经过灵膳师的加工处理就会变成对修士修炼有益的美味灵膳。
例如妖兽的血肉脏腑富含修士所需灵萃精华，常食用妖兽血肉制成的灵膳有助于增强修士的肉身之力，特别对炼体修士有极大好处。
但很多妖兽的肉质非常坚硬，用普通的手段很难烧制成灵膳，需要灵膳师用灵火或其它手段才能烧制出对修士修炼有益的美味灵膳。
今晚烤肉用的灵木炭就是刘长旭从家中带来的，用家族灵桃树的剪下树枝烧制的木炭。
为了能够让灵桃树结出品质更加的灵桃，家族的灵植师都会对其剪枝，而家族都会将灵桃树剪下树枝烧制成灵桃木炭。
灵桃木炭主要用于炼丹和烤肉，每年也可以为家族带来500块下品灵石的收入。

灵桃木炭的火焰温度高、燃烧稳定性好、烟气小、且带有桃木香味，很受炼丹师和灵膳师的欢迎。
很快烤肉的香味就弥漫在营地的空气中，小青早早的守在烤肉架前，用它两双渴望的眼神看着刘长旭，不断通过神魂传音向主人讨要烤肉。
显然，它已经等不及了，刘长旭只好不断的安抚小青。
在烤肉之时，刘长旭又蒸了一锅灵米饭。
在将蛇肉烤至金黄后，才将烤盘从烤架上拿下来，招呼众人前来食用。
众人也没和刘长旭客气，纷纷赶来享用烤肉。
小青也叼起一片烤肉，躲在一边享用起来！
刘长旭从储物袋取出一壶桃酿和几个白玉酒杯为众人满上。
桃山刘家的桃酿是采用碧玉灵桃自然发酵酿制而成，酒液晶莹剔透，富含灵桃精华，灵气充沛、香气浓郁、甘甜爽口、回味悠长！能补充修士法力，增益修士修为，很受炼气修士们的欢迎，是桃山刘家的两项主要收入来源，每年为刘家带来大量的灵石收益！
众人坐在一起，饮酒吃肉好不快活！
由于族人不少，烤肉的需要量就很大。刘长旭只好不停的烤肉才堪堪满足了众人的需要。
小青虽然才有手掌般大小，但也吃了很多烤肉，也不知道它吃的肉都到了哪里！
在刘家众修士中，尤以三伯父刘世杰和五哥刘长顺父子二人吃的最多，主要是这父子俩均是是体修，饭量一向很大。
父子两人均是身材高大魁梧，使用的法器也都是盘龙棍。
三伯父刘世杰今年55岁，也才达到炼气六层修为。
五哥刘长顺今年26岁了，也才刚刚突破了炼气三层。
但两人凭借着强大的肉身力量，在近身战斗中，常常能够越阶而战，实力不可小觑。
只是体修日常修炼消耗的灵物资源实在太多了，父子二人都很穷。
在众人吃饱喝足后，在感谢了刘长旭的款待后，纷纷盘膝而坐，运转法诀炼化腹中的食物。
（本章完）
content_en:
Chapter 5 Night Banquet in the Mountains
Liu Changxu is a person who is very particular about the life of cultivating immortals. He usually eats spiritual fruits and spiritual meals, and rarely eats mortal food and elixirs.
In order to eat delicious spiritual meals during this outing to hunt monsters, I specially brought these dining utensils and even some spiritual charcoal for barbecue in my storage bag.
He did not understand the life attitude of some monks who, in pursuit of immortality, did not marry Taoists and just practiced asceticism.
I don’t know what they want to cultivate for immortality. Is it long-term loneliness? Even if you cultivate to a higher realm and have longer longevity, so what!
He believes that the road to immortality is long and bumpy! On the road to pursuing immortality, in addition to constantly improving one's own cultivation so as to have longer longevity, one must also learn to enjoy the wonderful life of immortality.
His attitude towards life of cultivating immortals comes from his mother, who is a spiritual baker.
Mother Lin Yulian is very concerned about Liu Changxu's daily life of cultivating immortals, and always does her best to create the best living environment for Liu Changxu to cultivate immortals.
In order to lay a good foundation for his children to cultivate immortality from an early age, he began to learn how to make spiritual meals after his son was born, and did his best to provide all kinds of spiritual meals needed for his son's cultivation.
Although Liu Changxu's father is an alchemist, his mother Lin Yulian has asked Liu Changxu since he was a child not to take pills to improve his cultivation unless necessary.
This is because long-term use of elixirs will produce erysipelas in the monks' bodies. Over time, erysipelas will affect the monk's future breakthroughs in cultivation!
Under the influence of his mother, he also fell in love with making and eating spiritual meals, and regarded it as an important means to improve his cultivation. Long-term continuous consumption of spiritual meals laid a good foundation for Liu Changxu's path to immortality.
With the guidance and help of his mother Lin Yulian, Liu Changxu has basically reached the level of a first-level low-grade spiritual chef, especially the best in barbecue.
Spiritual baker is also one of the hundred arts of cultivating immortals. Many edible spiritual materials will be difficult to swallow and have poor edible effect if they are not processed by spiritual baker.
Different ingredients require different processing methods by spiritual chefs. The processing of many ingredients is very cumbersome, but after the processing by the spiritual chef, they will become delicious spiritual meals that are beneficial to the monks' cultivation.
For example, the flesh and blood organs of monsters are rich in the spiritual essence needed by monks. Regular consumption of spiritual meals made from the flesh and blood of monsters can help enhance the physical strength of monks, which is especially beneficial to body-refining monks.
However, the meat of many monster beasts is very hard, and it is difficult to cook it into spiritual meals using ordinary methods. Spiritual chefs need to use spiritual fire or other methods to cook delicious spiritual meals that are beneficial to monks' cultivation.
The spiritual charcoal used for the barbecue tonight was brought by Liu Changxu from home, and the charcoal was made from branches cut from the family's spiritual peach tree.
In order to make the spiritual peach tree produce higher quality spiritual peaches, the family's spiritual planter will prune its branches, and the family will cut off the branches of the spiritual peach tree and burn them into spiritual peach charcoal.
Lingtao charcoal is mainly used for alchemy and barbecue, and can also bring an income of 500 low-grade spiritual stones to the family every year.
Lingpeach charcoal has a high flame temperature, good combustion stability, low smoke, and a peach wood fragrance. It is very popular among alchemists and spiritual bakers.
Soon the aroma of barbecue filled the air of the camp. Xiaoqing stood in front of the barbecue early, looking at Liu Changxu with his longing eyes, and kept asking for barbecue from his master through soul transmission.
Obviously, it couldn't wait any longer, so Liu Changxu had to keep comforting Xiaoqing.
While grilling meat, Liu Changxu steamed another pot of rice.
After the snake meat is roasted until golden, the baking pan is taken off the grill and everyone is invited to come and eat.
Everyone was not polite to Liu Changxu and came to enjoy the barbecue.
Xiaoqing also picked up a piece of barbecue and hid aside to enjoy it!
Liu Changxu took out a pot of peach wine and several white jade wine glasses from his storage bag and filled them for everyone.Taoshan Liu's peach wine is brewed by natural fermentation of jasper peaches. The wine liquid is crystal clear and rich in peach essence. It is full of spirit, rich in aroma, sweet and refreshing, and has a long aftertaste! It can replenish the mana of monks and increase their cultivation. It is very popular among Qi refining monks. It is the two main sources of income for the Taoshan Liu family and brings a large amount of spiritual stone income to the Liu family every year!
Everyone is sitting together, drinking wine and eating meat, so happy!
Since there are many people in the clan, there is a huge demand for barbecue. Liu Changxu had no choice but to keep grilling meat to satisfy everyone's needs.
Although Xiao Qing is only about the size of a palm, he has eaten a lot of barbecued meat, and I don’t know where all the meat he ate went!
Among the monks in the Liu family, especially the third uncle Liu Shijie and the fifth brother Liu Changshun and his son eat the most. This is mainly because both father and son are physical practitioners and have always had a large appetite.
Both father and son are tall and burly, and the magical weapons they use are both coiling dragon sticks.
The third uncle, Liu Shijie, is 55 years old and has only reached the sixth level of Qi refining.
Fifth brother Liu Changshun is 26 years old this year and has just broken through the third level of Qi refining.
However, with their strong physical strength, the two of them were often able to fight across the ranks in close combat, and their strength should not be underestimated.
It’s just that the spiritual resources consumed by physical cultivation in daily practice are too much, and both father and son are very poor.
After everyone had eaten and drank enough, and thanked Liu Changxu for his hospitality, they all sat cross-legged and used magic formulas to refine the food in their bellies.
(End of chapter)
